paths.description: Homepage, anonymous login entry, marketing landing page, and mobile home experience.
Stories listing/feed archetype, including long-page navigation and crawler rendering.
Short-video feed/detail journey; /spotlight redirected to a representative Spotlight item.
Invalid route used to inspect HTTP/content recovery state.

findings.summary: The homepage ignores the user’s dark color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-emulated screenshot remains a white homepage, and computed styles report color-scheme: normal.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and theme surfaces with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark(), while preserving the intentionally dark content routes.

findings.summary: Smooth scrolling remains enabled under reduced-motion.
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion probe confirms the media query is active but reports html scroll-behavior: smooth.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable smooth scrolling and non-essential motion inside prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: Route and state changes do not use View Transitions.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection across six representative routes found no view-transition rules; navigation changes are full swaps.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document or cross-document View Transitions for supported route/state changes, with a no-motion fallback.

findings.summary: Long scrolling/media surfaces do not use declarative scroll timelines.
findings.evidence: CSS probes across all sampled templates found no animation-timeline or scroll-timeline despite long feed and marketing surfaces.
findings.suggestedFix: Move any scroll-linked reveals or progress effects to CSS scroll-driven animations and avoid scroll handlers for visual effects.

findings.summary: Long feed chrome does not communicate scroll position or react to it.
findings.evidence: The 4,955px Discover mobile page retains static navigation and has no scroll timeline/progress affordance in the screenshot or CSS probe.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight scroll-position or progress affordance where it helps orientation on long feeds.

findings.summary: Spotlight forces a desktop-sized layout on a 360px viewport.
findings.evidence: Layout metrics at 360x800 report innerWidth/scrollWidth 1020px and 660px horizontal overflow; the video is visibly offset and clipped.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the fixed/minimum desktop width, keep the layout viewport at device width, and size the Spotlight card intrinsically.

findings.summary: Reusable surfaces do not use component-level responsiveness, and Spotlight breaks in its narrow container.
findings.evidence: All six CSS probes found no container queries; the Spotlight component expands to 1020px at a 360px viewport.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable cards/feeds containment and adapt them with @container rules rather than relying only on global breakpoints.

findings.summary: Several visible controls are undersized or lose visible keyboard focus.
findings.evidence: The focus/target probe found 29–40px-high login controls and footer links, while the username/search inputs and several footer links computed outline: none after focus.
findings.suggestedFix: Use at least 44x44 CSS-pixel hit areas and a high-contrast :focus-visible treatment on every interactive element.

findings.summary: The anonymous login flow accepts an empty submission but makes no progress and gives no guidance.
findings.evidence: Clicking the enabled Log in button with an empty, non-required username field leaves the URL unchanged, does not focus the field, and renders no error or live-region message.
findings.suggestedFix: Make the identifier required, prevent empty submission, focus the field, and provide an actionable error before continuing the login flow.

findings.summary: The login flow has no visible or programmatic invalid state.
findings.evidence: After empty submission, aria-invalid remains absent, validationMessage is empty, focus does not move, and no alert/live-region text appears.
findings.suggestedFix: Synchronize visible validation with aria-invalid and an announced error after the user submits.

findings.summary: Homepage loading performance is poor under Lighthouse mobile conditions.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse scored performance 0.44 with LCP 20.3s, TBT 750ms, FCP 3.2s and TTI 20.6s; a separate trace measured LCP 5.10s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP poster, trim initial JavaScript, defer non-critical media, and remeasure on representative mobile conditions.

findings.summary: Initial JavaScript blocks the main thread.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 750ms TBT and 800ms max potential input delay; the independent trace recorded a 113ms long task.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unnecessary startup work and split remaining long tasks using scheduler/yielding techniques.

findings.summary: Critical resources are late, render-blocking, and poorly cached.
findings.evidence: HAR/Lighthouse show 4.29MB transferred, 2.03s estimated render-blocking savings, an LCP poster without fetchpriority=high, and 1.51MB cache-lifetime savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP poster, inline/split critical CSS, defer non-critical assets, and set long immutable cache lifetimes on versioned media.

findings.summary: The homepage ships a very large mostly-unused application bundle.
findings.evidence: HAR records 2.21MB of JavaScript including a 2.07MB _app chunk; Lighthouse estimates 1.50MB unused JavaScript and 24KB unused CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split the shared app bundle by route, remove dead dependencies, and load login/media modules only when needed.

findings.summary: Accessible names do not match visible mobile navigation labels.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports serious label-content-name-mismatch failures: visible “Lenses” and “Stories” links use aria-label values LENS_HOME_PAGE and DISCOVER_HOME_PAGE.
findings.suggestedFix: Use human-readable accessible names containing the visible label, or remove the overriding aria-label.

findings.summary: Heading hierarchy and focus treatment are inconsistent.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse flags H6 “Discover Snapchat” and H3 “Advertise” heading-order failures; focus probing found multiple controls with outline: none.
findings.suggestedFix: Use semantic heading levels in document order and ensure every keyboard target has a visible :focus-visible style.

findings.summary: Reflow and target sizing fail on key surfaces.
findings.evidence: Spotlight has 660px overflow at 360px, and the target probe reports several primary controls below 44px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix Spotlight reflow, preserve user scaling, and enlarge control hit areas without increasing visual clutter.

findings.summary: The homepage logs production exceptions and failed internal-tool requests.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse captured repeated React hydration errors 418/422/425 plus CORS/403 failures from growth-web-dev-tool.mesh.sc-corp.net.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the production call to the internal growth tool and fix server/client markup divergence causing hydration errors.

findings.summary: Image sizing and document heading structure have avoidable defects.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found the Bitmoji image without explicit width/height; probes found no H1 on Snapchat+ and two H1s on Lenses.
findings.suggestedFix: Add intrinsic image dimensions and give each page one clear H1 with a logical hierarchy.

findings.summary: Large production scripts expose broken source-map references and browser inspector issues.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports the 2MB app chunk has no usable source map (403), along with cookie and CSP inspector issues.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish protected but retrievable production source maps for diagnostics and resolve the browser Issues-panel warnings.

findings.summary: Important entity pages omit structured data.
findings.evidence: Homepage and Snapchat+ expose Open Graph metadata but zero JSON-LD blocks; Snapchat+ represents a paid product/subscription and has no Product/Offer metadata.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Organization/WebSite metadata on the homepage and Product/Offer structured data for Snapchat+ that matches visible terms.

findings.summary: Security policy and cookies are weaker than necessary.
findings.evidence: HTTPS/HSTS/CSP are present, but CSP allows unsafe-inline styles; nosniff and Referrer-Policy are absent. All four first-party cookies use SameSite=None, including year-long cookies.
findings.suggestedFix: Add nosniff and a strict Referrer-Policy, remove unsafe-inline through nonces/hashes where feasible, and use Lax/Strict cookies unless cross-site use is required.

findings.summary: A public homepage contacts an internal growth tool and starts an unnecessary OAuth redirect chain.
findings.evidence: HAR shows requests to growth-web-dev-tool.mesh.sc-corp.net that redirect to Google OAuth, fail CORS/403, set third-party cookies, and add network/console noise.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the internal growth-tool integration from production and audit every startup endpoint for necessity and data minimisation.

findings.summary: The visible sign-in entry offers only identifier-based login and no discoverable passkey option.
findings.evidence: The anonymous login screenshot and DOM expose username/email and phone-number paths but no passkey/WebAuthn affordance; no permission prompts fired on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer discoverable conditional passkey authentication where supported, while retaining account-recovery fallbacks.

findings.summary: Several browser-enforced defensive policies are missing.
findings.evidence: Headers evidence reports no Permissions-Policy or Referrer-Policy and no X-Content-Type-Options; CSP/frame protection and HSTS are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a least-privilege Permissions-Policy, strict referrer policy, nosniff, and evaluate Trusted Types for this script-heavy application.

findings.summary: Homepage core content is effectively absent without JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Discoverability measured only 2% raw/rendered content overlap, no raw H1, and isJsShell: true; the crawler screenshot shows only branding while the rendered page contains login and product content.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render the homepage’s headings, login/form shell, primary links, and essential copy, then hydrate enhancements.

findings.summary: Login validation silently ignores an empty submission.
findings.evidence: The identifier is not required and empty submission yields no message, focus, aria-invalid state, or recovery instruction.
findings.suggestedFix: Validate after submission, focus the invalid field, and announce a concise correction without blaming the user.

findings.summary: The login identifier lacks an autocomplete token.
findings.evidence: DOM inspection shows the “Username or email address” input has autocomplete="" and no name, reducing password-manager and autofill support.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a stable name and autocomplete="username"; use current-password or webauthn tokens on subsequent authentication fields.

findings.summary: Snapchat+ asks users to subscribe without showing price or renewal terms.
findings.evidence: Desktop and mobile screenshots show benefits, QR/Subscribe CTA, and no visible price, billing interval, renewal, or cancellation terms before commitment.
findings.suggestedFix: Show localized price, billing cadence, renewal/cancellation terms, and confirmation before launching purchase.

findings.summary: Homepage poster images are oversized legacy PNGs.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 1.34MB image savings across four video posters; individual PNGs waste 248–446KB and the Bitmoji image is oversized.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve AVIF/WebP responsive posters sized to their rendered cards and include explicit dimensions.

findings.summary: Startup performs wasteful work unrelated to the user’s task.
findings.evidence: The page loads 70 requests and contacts an internal growth endpoint that redirects through Google OAuth and fails; autoplay media and analytics also start immediately.
findings.suggestedFix: Delete the internal request, lazy-init analytics/media, and deprioritize non-user-initiated background fetches.

findings.summary: Media and script cost is disproportionate on the landing page.
findings.evidence: HAR records 4.29MB transferred: 2.21MB scripts and 1.44MB images, while four autoplay loop videos are present and Lighthouse scores performance 0.44.
findings.suggestedFix: Load only the first visible poster initially, require or defer playback, suspend offscreen loops, and split the shared script bundle.

taskList.title: Cut startup JavaScript and media, prioritize LCP, and fix cache/render-blocking delivery.
Server-render the homepage’s essential content and structured metadata before hydration.
Fix Spotlight mobile reflow and make reusable cards container-responsive.
Make login validation actionable, accessible, and autofill-friendly.
Remove the production internal growth-tool request and resolve React hydration errors.
Strengthen security headers, cookie posture, and browser defensive policies.
Repair accessible names, headings, focus visibility, and target sizing.
Show Snapchat+ price, renewal, and cancellation terms before subscribe.
Respect dark mode and reduced-motion preferences.
Add lightweight navigation progress and modern route/scroll transitions.
Offer a discoverable passkey authentication path where supported.
Publish usable production source maps and clear browser inspector warnings.
